lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a staggered grid arrangement with higher density and larger diameters in the central lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the spot centroids to form a rectilinear grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible running parallel to the body axis; the lower ridge begins near the dorsal terminus of the gill slits, exhibiting a sharp transition from a high-luminance upper edge to a low-luminance shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive concentric-ringed spot (bullseye pattern) is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin near the central-posterior margin.
